text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning, while heading to the academy,
El Condor Pasa came running up to me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sì! After all,
I woke up right along with the sun!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Today, El shines as high in the sky as the sun itself, yes it is true!!
choice_data_list: Does that mean you're feeling good?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer,
please be careful not to get burned!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The flames of passion cannot be controlled, desu!
